results.overview: A young woman from the Peruvian Andes faces a difficult journey as she struggles to overcome poverty, family conflicts, and the challenges of adapting to life in a changing society. Set in Peru, the series explores family, ambition, identity, and the clash between traditional Andean values and modern life.
results.name: El gran reto

results.overview: Doña Hortensia sees her life turned upside down with the return of her beloved son, Carlitos, who after 15 years of absence decides to return to Ecuador in the company of his wife. For him, as for everyone, this will cause an inner disorder that will make them question his life and his true desires.
results.name: El gran retorno
